title: sensor_deployment
description: One device as used on one award, extracted from an unstructured source (workshop notes, a slide deck, a transcript). This is the contract every extractor meets, human or LLM: ingestion_records.payload for record_kind 'sensor_deployment' is exactly this object, and promote_ingestion_record() turns it into sensor_deployments rows. Presenter NAMES are not part of the payload; they go to sensor_deployment_presenters, which only curators can read.

label_as_named.description: The device as the source names it, verbatim.

award_label.description: The award as the source names it (often a place: 'Michigan', 'Duke/Dunn').

grant_number.description: Resolved NIH grant number without the application-type prefix; null when unresolved.

grant_match.description: How award_label was resolved: stated in the source; presenter or lab is a named lead; the only BBQS grant at that place; matched by grant title; best of several candidates; not resolved.

grant_note.description: Why the match is uncertain, and the other candidates.

presenter_role.description: Who spoke to it, as a role ('PI (name)', 'Postdoc, Suthana lab'). PIs may be named; nobody else.

presenter_present.description: False when no presenter spoke to the row: nothing in it was confirmed aloud.

verify_note.description: What still needs confirming. Required when presenter_present is false.

device_models.description: device_models.model_name of each matching catalogue model; empty when none matches yet.

model_status.description: How the model is known: compiled from vendor sources (not the source document), inferred, several candidates, custom/in-house, or not stated.

system_kind.description: platform = a rig recording several modalities (one hosted sensor per observed property).

measures_recorded.description: The source's own words for what is measured, verbatim.
